anchor: BGP neighbor keeps going down, hold timer expired
related: BGP session flapping: check the last reset reason and perform a soft reset of the peer
unrelated: High VSWR on the radio unit: inspect the jumper and connector on the antenna branch

related: PTP / GNSS sync loss: the baseband enters holdover, check satellites and the grandmaster
unrelated: Configure QoS policy map to prioritise voice traffic with DSCP EF

anchor: CRC errors increasing on uplink interface
related: Interface input errors: check optical receive power and clean the fibre connectors
unrelated: Upgrade the gNodeB software package and activate the new release

anchor: UEs cannot register, NG link to AMF is down
related: NG-C SCTP association to the AMF is not established; ping the N2 address
unrelated: Line card temperature critical: check the fan tray and site HVAC

anchor: How do I roll back a bad configuration change?
related: Undo a committed change with rollback 1 followed by commit; commit confirmed rolls back automatically
unrelated: Radio unit VSWR test mutes the branch under test for 20 seconds
